description:
Remove an EXTRA Odoo instance (stop+disable its unit, delete its unit/config/
    nginx site, drop its DB, wipe its data_dir). Refuses the PRIMARY (index 0 / the
    .deb's own `odoo`) - that is torn down with bootstrap_reset, not here. DESTRUCTIVE:
    dry_run shows what it would delete; then it needs confirm=true. If the instance's
    DB still holds real business data (many partners/users) it also requires force=true
    so you can't nuke a live client by mistake. Find the slug/db with instance_list.
name: instance_remove
